verdict.rationale: AgentMail is email infrastructure for agents. The evidence shows primitives that a separate assistant or a developer could use: full-text thread search, organization-wide thread retrieval, a hosted MCP server exposing inbox and calendar tools, and a LangChain recipe for indexing messages into a vector store. None of the evidence documents a first-party assistant that answers grounded questions across a user's inbox and calendar, so these count only as building blocks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask an assistant questions across my whole inbox and calendar — who said what, what's outstanding — and get grounded answers
